description: Plain-language sample queries for /brief-intake that have been pre-validated to produce non-zero audience results from the dummy Rituals dataset. Each query is what a marketer would type; the brief-intake skill will clarify and write a JSON intake artifact, which audience-finder then turns into a per-channel audience analysis.

policy_baseline.channel_default_when_not_named: all channels (Email, SMS, Push Notification, In-App Banner, Display Retargeting, Paid Social - Meta, Paid Social - Google)

queries.text: Promote our new spring fragrance line to loyal customers in NL, DE and BE
queries.intent: Drive trial of a new product line to engaged repeat customers across the core EU markets.
queries.demo_notes: Strongest narrative pick. Multi-country (shows scale), on-brand for Rituals (fragrance), large enough pool to feel real, triggers cross-border SCC callout because Klaviyo / Braze / Meta Ads Manager are US-hosted. Recipe match maps cleanly to the historical new-arrival playbook.

queries.text: Send a welcome offer to our new customers in Germany
queries.intent: First-purchase follow-up to nudge a second order.
queries.demo_notes: Single-market, single-segment, tight story. Biggest single segment x country cell in the mailable file. Good if you want a focused demo without too many numbers on screen.

queries.text: Send a Black Friday VIP preview to our high-value customers in the Netherlands
queries.intent: Boutique-feel early access for top-tier customers ahead of the public Black Friday push.
queries.demo_notes: Small but premium-feeling audience. Cleanest demo if the audience wants to see concrete customer IDs without being overwhelmed. Black Friday framing is timely and self-explanatory.

queries.text: Send personalised product recommendations to our loyal customers in NL based on their purchase history
queries.intent: 1:1 personalised cross-sell using each customer's order history.
queries.demo_notes: Best query for showing compliance smarts. Triggers profiling_consent — the agent will explain that personalisation needs an extra opt-in beyond marketing consent, and only customers who have both opt-ins make the cut. Demonstrates that the system understands the difference between 'we can email you' and 'we can email you a tailored message'.

queries.text: Re-engage our at-risk customers in NL, DE and BE with a comeback offer
queries.intent: Win-back campaign for customers flagged at-risk of churn.
queries.demo_notes: Great query to show the 'include inactive with consent' policy in action — several mailable At-Risk customers are CRM-inactive but still consented, and they would have been silently dropped under the old default. A tighter 'lapsed 6 to 12 months ago' window yields 0 in the dummy data, so keep the framing broad (rely on the At-Risk segment tag rather than a specific last_order date window).

anti_demos.text: Re-engage lapsed luxury customers in DE via SMS for Black Friday
anti_demos.why_skip: Useful for showing the OLD failure mode (0 eligible due to retention + SMS opt-in drop), but a noisy story on stage. Keep available as a 'before/after' if you want to demo the inactive-with-consent policy fix explicitly.

anti_demos.text: Create a promotion for inactive customers that churned in the last 1 year
anti_demos.why_skip: The dummy data has no At-Risk customers with last_order_date in the 6-12 month window, so the audience-finder returns 0 across every channel. Same caveat as above — keep for the 'why this is hard' part of the talk, not the headline demo.
